findings.title: Harvests on the To date are left out of the stats (and Dec 31 out of the dashboard top plant)
findings.expected: A harvest of 777 g on 2026-03-15 is counted for from=2026-03-15&to=2026-03-15 (the To date is inclusive)
findings.actual: total_grams 0, harvest_count 0; the page says '0 harvests from 15 Mar 2026 to 15 Mar 2026' and 'No harvests in this range'. The query uses harvested_on < to, so the last day is always dropped

findings.title: A malformed stats response throws an uncaught error and leaves 'Loading stats…' on screen with old data
findings.expected: A visible error message, no uncaught exception, no lasting loading state
findings.actual: pageError 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')'; the status line stays on 'Loading stats…' and the content from the previous range stays visible
findings.evidence: {"pe":["Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')"],"alerts":["Loading stats…"]} | {"pe":["Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'length')"],"alerts":["Loading stats…"]}
